Joppa or Japho = "beautiful"
a town on the southwest coast of Palestine in the territory of Dan; became primary port of Jerusalem during reign of Solomon
Also named: Ioppē (Ἰόππη "Joppa" G2445)

1) to breathe, breathe hard, puff
1a) (Hithpael) to gasp for breath
a breathing out, exhaling, puffing out (subst)
beauty

A man living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at Jos.10.3
§ Japhia = "shining"
1) a town on the border of Zebulun and Issachar
1a) perhaps modern 'Yafa'
2) the king of Lachish at the time of the conquest of Canaan by Joshua
3) a son of David by a concubine
